files.text:
# Seed registry for the `us-apply-duplicate-collapse` BDD fixture.
#
# Engineered so `us apply 95.1 --fix` walks its single AC through the
# SHIPPED us-apply checklist and exercises the duplicate branch:
#
#   - "present?" PASSES: at least one entry references story
#     docs/product/stories/95.1-duplicate-collapse.yaml with lineage 95.1-001.
#   - "duplicate?" FAILS: E2E-900 and E2E-901 BOTH reference lineage
#     95.1-001. The F: collapses them into a single entry (keep the
#     lower id, union user_stories and merged_steps, delete the loser).
#
# After the collapse fix the walker restarts, both prompts pass, the
# outer re-walk confirms the fixpoint, and the scratch registry is
# committed over this file.
#
# E2E-950 is unrelated on purpose: it anchors the "leave every other
# entry alone" assertion.

metadata:
  title: "Test Requirements Registry (BDD fixture seed)"
  version: "2.0"
  last_updated: "2026-07-25"
  description: "Duplicate-entry seed for us-apply-duplicate-collapse fixture"

scenarios:
  E2E-900:
    description: "MCP /mcp endpoint responds 200 to a valid initialize POST"
    service: "mcp-service"
    last_updated: "2026-07-25"
    user_stories:
      - story: "docs/product/stories/95.1-duplicate-collapse.yaml"
        scenario_id: "95.1-001"
        merge_date: "2026-07-25"
    merged_steps:
      given:
        - "the MCP server is running on its configured port"
        - "the server accepts JSON-RPC over HTTP POST at /mcp"
      when:
        - "the Claude User posts a valid JSON-RPC initialize request to /mcp"
      then:
        - "the server returns HTTP 200"
        - "the response body is a well-formed JSON-RPC envelope referencing the request id"
  E2E-950:
    description: "Unrelated scenario that must remain untouched"
    service: "web-service"
    last_updated: "2026-07-25"
    user_stories:
      - story: "docs/product/stories/90.1-unrelated.yaml"
        scenario_id: "90.1-001"
        merge_date: "2026-07-25"
    merged_steps:
      given:
        - "the web app is running"
      when:
        - "the Claude User navigates to the home page"
      then:
        - "the home page renders a welcome banner"
